@sepo-agent /answer 

Some design problems:

Why we can set display model in AGENT_MODEL_POLICY but also allowing AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL?

Also for model reasoning effort, double check if acpx allow setting it properly? (I remember there were some previous bugs

Yes, both are valid concerns.

For display: current behavior is `AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL` overrides `AGENT_MODEL_POLICY.display.enabled` if set, then policy display is used, then default false. That is implemented here: [`resolve-provider.js#L251-L254`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/agent/implement-issue-336/codex-26252764032/.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.js#L251-L254).

The rationale is “simple global emergency toggle outside JSON,” but I agree it is probably too much surface area. Since display is not really model selection policy, I’d simplify before merge: keep `AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL` as the only display toggle and remove `display.enabled` from `AGENT_MODEL_POLICY`. That avoids two sources of truth.

For reasoning effort: ACPX 0.6.1 does support the Codex config path through `thought_level`, which maps to Codex ACP `reasoning_effort`. The PR uses that for named/transient sessions: [`acpx-adapter.ts#L315-L320`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/agent/implement-issue-336/codex-26252764032/.agent/src/acpx-adapter.ts#L315-L320). Claude effort is passed through `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL`: [`run.ts#L290-L294`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/agent/implement-issue-336/codex-26252764032/.agent/src/run.ts#L290-L294).

But there is still a gap: Codex reasoning effort is only applied when we create/use a session. The PR covers persistent lanes and `track-only` exec lanes, including transient exec sessions: [`acpx-adapter.ts#L700-L748`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/agent/implement-issue-336/codex-26252764032/.agent/src/acpx-adapter.ts#L700-L748). Plain `session_policy: none` exec routes can receive `reasoning_effort` from policy, but Codex will not actually get `thought_level` because no session setup runs. ACPX has global `--model`, but not an equivalent global reasoning flag in this path.

I’d fix that by creating a transient Codex exec session whenever `thoughtLevel` is set for an exec run, not only for `track-only`. Also add a test for `session_policy: none` / Codex / reasoning effort so we don’t regress this again. Current focused tests pass, but they only prove the covered session paths.
